architecture_principle: The bottleneck is no longer prompt quality. It is observation scale + centralized persistence + real store outcomes.

probe_ordering.reasoning: Every downstream task should act on this hour's freshest candidate set.

value_assessment.what_it_does: Collapses uncertainty by finding hidden channels, calculating commercial thresholds, and identifying human_action_required points
value_assessment.example: Testo 550s: discovered Max Sievert A-S → Norwegian wholesale → calculated dealer-cost threshold ≤ NOK 3,643 → froze when human contact needed
value_assessment.pattern: hypothesis → hidden-channel investigation → commercial facts → numerical threshold → HUMAN_ACTION_REQUIRED → freeze

freshness.why_still_fresh: Each candidate has different hidden channels to discover. The act of collapsing uncertainty is inherently non-repeating.
freshness.expected_saturation: When all active candidates have resolved supplier paths

lifecycle.phase_1: Deep dive on each candidate (high value)
lifecycle.retirement_signal: All candidates have resolved supplier paths

probes.name: Product-Market Opportunity Radar

scores.current_effectiveness: Very good, but not scanning broadly enough

value_assessment.what_it_does: Defines search space by scanning PRODUCT × COUNTRY cells. Currently doing ~20 observations/hour but mostly permutations of 3 families.
value_assessment.strength: Correctly kills weak candidates (Makita DWD181) and promotes strong ones (Testo 550s Norway)
value_assessment.weakness: Not doing true mass scan yet. Should be 5,000 SKUs × 15 countries = 75,000 cells with machine collection.
value_assessment.pattern: mass_scan → anomaly_cells → deep_investigation → DEMAND_VERIFIED or KILL

freshness.why_declining: Same categories being scanned repeatedly. Needs broader SKU universe.
freshness.expected_saturation: When top 50 anomaly cells have been investigated

probes.evolution_path: Should eventually become the analyst sitting on top of BigQuery, not the crawler itself.

probes.name: Store Launch Blueprint Engine

value_assessment.what_it_does: Policy/portfolio/state-transition layer. Consumes probe outputs and makes ADVANCE/HOLD/KILL/LAUNCH decisions.
value_assessment.strength: Stops us from chasing shiny objects. Correctly killed Davis Norway retail and Makita Finland while preserving Davis as content opportunity.
value_assessment.weakness: Not a research probe. Should consume almost no expensive research itself.

freshness.why_declining: Same format, same verdicts. Should become deterministic.
freshness.expected_saturation: When it becomes a pure state machine

probes.evolution_path: Should become: BigQuery state + probe deltas + hard gates → decision. No research needed.

probes.name: Free-Traffic Query Radar

value_assessment.what_it_does: Finds commercially meaningful decision problems via search queries. Correctly distinguishes CONTENT_GAP from MERCHANT_GAP.
value_assessment.strength: Excellent at identifying what people search for and what's missing
value_assessment.weakness: Sometimes does detailed content planning BEFORE we know if the commercial opportunity survives

freshness.why_declining: Same categories, same queries. Needs broader SKU universe.
freshness.expected_saturation: When top 50 anomaly cells have query analysis

probes.evolution_path: Should become the experimental-validation layer, not core discovery. Once we own thousands of market cells, query analysis becomes valuable for top 1%.

probes.name: Commerce Trace Radar

scores.current_effectiveness: Least useful hourly; scheduling is wrong

value_assessment.what_it_does: Collects STATE → ACTION → OUTCOME traces from operator discussions. Best for longitudinal corpus building.
value_assessment.strength: Excellent long-term dataset value. Found genuine later outcomes (Shopify/PayPal checkout failure).
value_assessment.weakness: Runs too frequently. 08:00 run investigated Davis and Makita, then 08:05 Product-Market killed both. Inefficient.

freshness.why_still_fresh: New operator traces appear regularly. Value is cumulative.
freshness.expected_saturation: Never fully — value is in corpus depth, not novelty

probes.evolution_path: Run less frequently but go deeper each time. Focus on Grade A traces only.
